method: Saved public-browser evidence and dossiers inspected locally; two primary public pages reopened for read-only text verification. No remote DOM mutation, transactions, theme install or owner-store mutation.

cases.state: Public PDP, conventional purchase rail and dimension tiles. First saved desktop product media is unloaded; blank area is not a deliberate layout finding.
cases.directObservation: The public product page provides dimensions near the evaluation content and a conventional quantity/purchase region.
cases.buyerProblem: An adult needs to understand a physical object's size and contents before ordering.
cases.retainedConvention: Product media beside explicit purchase controls and factual dimensions.
cases.originalDifference: Playfield places merchant age/warning at selection and a complete countable 12+2+1 contents panel with a text-equivalent schematic below. No compatibility, certification or age guarantee is inferred from imagery.
cases.requiredContract: C bounded merchant toy facts and safe Liquid projection; A existing variant/cart mechanics. Actual units and selected SKU must agree.
cases.limits: No reference purchase, nonempty-cart, provider checkout, keyboard, conversion or performance outcome was tested. Current reopening verifies text, not fresh pixel geometry.

cases.state: Public homepage full page. Some lower media unloaded in the saved desktop capture. Opening collage/catalog and category modules are visible.
cases.directObservation: Saved evidence has a collage-led opening, a product grid, category pathways and preparation education. The reopened page text retains product and educational entries.
cases.buyerProblem: An unfamiliar range needs useful category pathways and enough product context.
cases.retainedConvention: Clear category entry and explanatory product context.
cases.originalDifference: Playfield begins with two explicit adult age/interest inputs, then an activity bento and age bands. Its collection shows contents per card and independently removable filters. It has no copied food campaign, ratings or shipping promise.
cases.requiredContract: B/C schema-selected guided bento; C AND-composed paginated age/interest query; merchant-supplied age/contents data.
cases.limits: The reference is food-oriented, not evidence that a theme named Crave is a toy niche. Its energetic hierarchy informs a design hypothesis; no conversion superiority is claimed.

neutralStructures: neutral.html uses original HTML diagrams, no Shopify assets or copied layout source. Photography, accent palette and theme wordmarks are suppressed. Labelled task zones expose Playfield vs gifts/apparel differences.
productionUse: Reference screenshots are research evidence only; not production assets or part of the 45 mockup ZIP.
